questions.ex: 问句用现在进行时描述动作。

questions.q: These are ________ pictures.
questions.kp: 名词性物主代词的用法
questions.ex: 空格后有名词pictures，需用形容词性物主代词。

questions.q: — Whose storybooks are those? — They are ________.
questions.ex: 名词所有格Sam's在这相当于名词性物主代词。

questions.q: What is Mike doing? He is ________ with his dog.
questions.ex: is playing正在玩。

questions.q: These pencils are ________.
questions.ex: 意为“我们的（铅笔）”，用ours。

questions.q: “Keep your desk clean”的意思是“保持桌面整洁”。
questions.ex: Keep clean意为保持整洁，your desk意为你的课桌。

questions.q: 在图书馆我们要“Talk loudly”。
questions.ex: 在图书馆应保持安静，应为Talk quietly。

questions.q: “Is he drinking water?”是一个正确的现在进行时疑问句。
questions.ex: 现在进行时疑问句结构为：Is/Are + 主语 + 动词ing形式。

questions.q: “Take turns”的意思是“各走各的”。
questions.ex: Take turns的意思是“轮流”。

questions.q: “Keep to the right”的意思是“靠右行”。
questions.ex: Keep to the right是常用的交通规则或行为准则，指靠右。

questions.q: — Are they eating lunch? — ________
questions.kp: 现在进行时一般疑问句
questions.ex: 含有are的疑问句，肯定回答用Yes, 主语 + are.

questions.q: Look! The panda is ________ bamboo.
questions.ex: Look是现在进行时的标志词，需用be + 动词ing。

questions.q: Shh! Keep ________. The baby is sleeping.
questions.ex: Keep + 形容词表示保持某种状态，keep quiet表示保持安静。

questions.q: Is ________ listening to music?
questions.ex: 系动词是Is，主语应为单数第三人称。

questions.q: Which word has a different sound for 'wh'?
questions.ex: whose中wh发/h/音，其他三个单词中wh发/w/音。

questions.q: We should ________ turns when we play games.
questions.ex: 情态动词should后接动词原形，take turns是固定搭配。

questions.q: Keep ________ the right when you walk upstairs.
questions.ex: Keep to the right是固定用法，意为靠右行。

questions.q: What is Tom ________ now?
questions.ex: What is ... doing? 询问正在做什么。

questions.q: — Is she reading a book? — ________. She is drawing.
questions.ex: 根据后一句She is drawing可知，前一句是否定回答。

questions.q: The books are ________. They are reading at the table.
questions.kp: 名词性物主代词与进行时结合
questions.ex: 此处需要名词性物主代词作表语，theirs意为“他们的书”。

questions.q: 将下列单词连成句子：
questions.ex: 祈使句。保持你的桌面整洁。

questions.q: “writing”是“write”的正确ing形式。
questions.ex: 以不发音e结尾的单词，去e再加ing。

questions.q: 单词“who”中的“wh”发和“what”中一样的音。
questions.ex: who中wh发/h/，what中wh发/w/。

questions.q: “Don't food here”是一个正确的英文句子。
questions.ex: Don't后面应接动词，应为Don't eat here。

questions.q: “They are listen to the teacher.”语法完全正确。
questions.ex: are后接动词应使用ing形式，应为listening。

questions.q: “Talk quietly”意味着“小声说话”。
questions.ex: talk意思是说，quietly意思是小声地、安静地。

questions.q: Someone is sleeping. You should say: ________
questions.ex: 有人睡觉时，应提醒他人小声说话。

questions.q: — Are ________ drawing? — Yes, we are.
questions.ex: 由回答we are可知，问句对应的是you（多指你们）。

questions.q: Can you ________? Yes, I am ________ now.
questions.ex: Can后接原形，am后接ing形式。

questions.q: — ________ is she? — She is in the library.
questions.ex: 根据回答地点可知用Where提问。

questions.q: When we wait in line, we should ________.
questions.ex: 排队等候时应该轮流/按序。

questions.q: Which word has the same sound as 'white'?
questions.ex: white和whale的wh都发/w/音。

questions.q: “Keep to the right” translates to ________.
questions.ex: right是右边的意思。

questions.q: The students ________ hard in the classroom.
questions.ex: 主语students是复数，用are + ing。

questions.q: ________ any noise here.
questions.ex: 否定祈使句结构：Don't + 动词原形。

questions.q: — Whose book is it? — It's ________. She ________ it.
questions.ex: 名词性物主代词hers作表语，后半句描述正在进行的动作。

questions.q: 将单词排成句子：
questions.ex: 祈使句，提示在图书馆保持安静。
